introduction.request_received: We acknowledge receipt of your letter dated %s and are pleased to provide the requested information below.
article_3_94.section_1.title: Pursuant to Article 3.94 §1
article_3_94.section_1.fund_balances.tit: 1° the amount of the working capital and reserve fund, within the meaning of §5, paragraphs 2 and 3;
article_3_94.section_1.seller_arrears.ti: 2° the amount of any arrears owed by the transferor;
article_3_94.section_1.scheduled_fund_re: 3° the status of fund calls intended for the reserve fund and decided by the general meeting before the established date of the transfer of ownership;
article_3_94.section_1.judiciary_procedu: 4° where applicable, a statement of ongoing legal proceedings relating to the co-ownership;
article_3_94.section_1.general_assembly_: 5° the minutes of ordinary and extraordinary general meetings held during the previous three years, as well as the periodic statements of charges for the previous two years;
article_3_94.section_1.latest_balance_sh: 6° a copy of the latest balance sheet approved by the general meeting
article_3_94.section_2.title: Pursuant to Article 3.94 §2
article_3_94.section_2.maintenance_expen: 1° the amount of conservation, maintenance, repair and renovation expenses decided by the general meeting or the property manager before the established date of the transfer of ownership, but for which payment is requested by the property manager after that date;
article_3_94.section_2.fund_requests.tit: 2° a statement of the fund calls approved by the general meeting of co-owners before the established date of the transfer of ownership and the cost of urgent works for which payment is requested by the property manager after that date;
article_3_94.section_2.commons_acquisiti: 3° a statement of the costs associated with the acquisition of common areas, decided by the general meeting before the established date of the transfer of ownership, but for which payment is requested by the property manager after that date;
article_3_94.section_2.condominium_debts: 4° a statement of established debts owed by the association of co-owners as a result of disputes arising before the established date of the transfer of ownership, but for which payment is requested by the property manager after that date.
article_3_94.section_2.seller_arrears.ti: 5° the amount of any arrears owed by the transferor;
article_3_94.section_3.title: Pursuant to Article 3.94 §3
article_3_94.section_3.notary_informatio: In the event of a transfer or division of ownership rights to a private unit, the officiating notary informs the property manager of the date on which the deed is executed, the identification of the private unit concerned, and the identity and current and, where applicable, future address of the persons concerned.
article_3_94.section_3.change_notificati: Please notify us of these changes as soon as possible.
